character: A resort in Big Cottonwood Canyon just down-canyon from Brighton, with a small pedestrian base village, groomed intermediate runs and advanced bowl and tree terrain such as Honeycomb Canyon.
learning: Reference note: beginner terrain is centred on the Moonbeam base area, and the resort runs a ski and snowboard school. Confirm current learning lifts, carpets and lesson products.

airports.basis: Estimate from typical routing (I-80 E and I-215 S to Exit 6 / 6200 South, Wasatch Blvd to the canyon mouth, then SR-190 up Big Cottonwood Canyon); not a routing-service result. Storm days, traction-law enforcement and avalanche-control closures of SR-190 can add hours.

transfers.name: UTA ski bus (Big Cottonwood Canyon service)
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: Utah Transit Authority has run winter ski-bus service from Salt Lake Valley park-and-ride lots up SR-190 to Solitude and Brighton. 2026-27 routes, schedule and fares are unconfirmed.

transfers.name: Shared or private airport shuttles from SLC
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: several private operators run airport transfers to the Cottonwood Canyon and Park City resorts. No operator, fare or schedule is on file.

transfers.name: Rental car from SLC
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: Utah applies a winter traction law in the Cottonwood canyons (SR-190 Big Cottonwood) that can require 4WD/AWD or suitable snow tires/chains. Parking rules for 2026-27 are unknown.

conflicts: 2025-26 closing: a search summary listed Solitude closing on May 17, 2026. It is not recorded because no source page was identified. The earlier reason given for doubting it (a warm, early-closing Utah season, with Deer Valley closing Mar. 29) is weak: neighbouring Brighton, in the same canyon, extended its 2025-26 season to May 10, 2026 after late snowfall (TownLift; Brighton press release). Confirm.
OnTheSnow 2025-26 two-day adult price ($262) is well below two single days ($390) — dynamic sample prices; confirm.
research.confidenceNotes: 2026-10-03 CI fetch: Solitude homepage (blog only), OnTheSnow lift-ticket page (2025-26 daily table, read directly) and the Salt Lake Tribune 2026-27 opening list were read; all other solitudemountain.com pages came back empty. Lesson prices and the official opening-event source remain earlier search summaries. The 2026-27 peak price ($199) comes from a TownLift article (Sep 4, 2026) saved under Deer Valley.
